reference:
To determine which 2008 American documentary film delves into fiscal issues, I identified the documentaries mentioned in the paragraphs and reviewed their descriptions. The documentary "I.O.U.S.A." is described as focusing on the shape and impact of the United States national debt, featuring discussions on the potential dangers of the national debt.

FINDING: I.O.U.S.A. delves into fiscal issues.
